defaults.suffix: Photoreal, documentary, natural light, soft contrast, true colour, fine film grain. One continuous shot, slow and physical camera move, no cuts. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, neon, lens flare, bokeh circles, light orbs, purple, glowing orbs or rockets. Phone and laptop screens are never visible to the camera.
defaults.stillSuffix: Colour grade for the whole set: neutral overcast daylight, quiet and precise, muted greys, charcoal, slate navy and off-white, warm natural skin, one small ochre or mustard accent in clothing where it fits, soft contrast, no orange and teal look. Tight editorial crop, shallow depth of field, 85mm lens. Shot on a full-frame camera, natural light, soft contrast, true skin texture with pores and fine detail, true colour, subtle fine film grain, editorial documentary photograph. No text, letters, numbers, logos, crests, brand marks or watermarks anywhere, including on clothing, signs and devices. Phone and laptop screens are never visible to the camera. No purple, neon or lens flare. Hands have five fingers each and hold devices naturally. Nobody is holding a pencil, paper, a notebook or a calculator. Laptop lids and phone backs are plain, with no logo of any kind.
